I am young, only 18, and this small bean plot is just 0.09 hectares, intercropped with my maize. Beans fix their own nitrogen so I do not waste precious fertilizer on them — if I get any FISP coupon, it goes on the maize. I will use the local bean seed I saved from last harvest, and put some manure from our goats if I have any left. I cannot afford pesticides or hired labor for such a small plot, and there is no irrigation here — we wait for the rains.
